canonical_name: Schlickewei--Evertse finiteness theorem for nondegenerate recurrence zeros
canonical_statement: Let K be a characteristic-zero field. For every positive integer r and every family of nonzero coefficients c_i and nonzero roots alpha_i in K such that alpha_i / alpha_j is not torsion whenever i != j, the set of natural numbers n for which the sum over i of c_i * alpha_i^n is zero is finite.
domain_and_universes: K : Type u with Field K and CharZero K; r n : Nat; i j : Fin r; proposition lives in the appropriate Lean universe
data_hypotheses: for i != j, root i / root j is not of finite multiplicative order
conclusion: the set {n : Nat | sum_i coeff_i * root_i^n = 0} is finite
excluded_degenerate_cases: zero coefficients or zero characteristic roots
repeated-root polynomial factors and polynomial-in-n coefficients
